channel.title: Past Mystery
channel.description: Evidence-based explainers on ancient mysteries, unusual historical events, and unexplained phenomena.

item.title: The Oak Island Money Pit: 200 Years of Treasure Hunting
item.description: A mysterious pit on a Nova Scotia island has captivated treasure hunters for over two centuries. Elaborate flood tunnels, tantalizing artifacts, and a legendary curse keep the search alive.

item.title: The Marfa Lights: Texas Desert's Glowing Mystery
item.description: Glowing orbs of light have appeared regularly in the West Texas desert for over 140 years. Despite scientific studies, no one can fully explain the Marfa Lights.

item.title: The Dyatlov Pass Incident: Nine Hikers Died Under Impossible Circumstances
item.description: In 1959, nine experienced Soviet hikers were found dead in the Ural Mountains under bizarre conditions — some with crushing injuries, some with missing body parts, all partially clothed in freezing temperatures.

item.title: D.B. Cooper: The Only Unsolved Skyjacking in American History
item.description: In 1971, a man hijacked a commercial flight, collected $200,000 in ransom, and parachuted into the night sky — never to be seen again. New FBI files released in 2025 have reignited the hunt.

item.title: Cleopatra's Lost Tomb: Where Is Egypt's Last Queen Buried?
item.description: The tomb of Cleopatra VII, the last pharaoh of Egypt, has never been found. A 2025 underwater port discovery near Taposiris Magna has reignited the search.

item.title: Amelia Earhart: 88 Years Later, Are We Close to Finding Her Plane?
item.description: Amelia Earhart vanished during her 1937 around-the-world flight. New satellite imagery and competing expeditions in 2025 may finally solve aviation's greatest mystery.

item.title: The Philadelphia Experiment: Did the Navy Make a Ship Invisible?
item.description: In 1943, the U.S. Navy allegedly made the USS Eldridge disappear using electromagnetic fields. Was it real government technology or an elaborate hoax?

item.title: The Bermuda Triangle: Why Do Ships and Planes Keep Disappearing?
item.description: An area of the Atlantic Ocean where dozens of ships and aircraft have vanished without explanation. What is really happening in the Bermuda Triangle?

item.title: The Wow! Signal: Did We Receive a Message From Aliens in 1977?
item.description: In 1977, a radio telescope picked up a signal from space so strong that a scientist wrote "Wow!" on the printout. Was it extraterrestrial intelligence?

item.title: Derinkuyu Underground City: 20,000 People Lived Beneath Turkey!
item.description: A massive underground city in Turkey that housed 20,000 people across 18 levels. Who built Derinkuyu and why did they live underground?

item.title: The Ghost Army: How Fake Tanks and Sound Effects Helped Win WWII
item.description: A secret U.S. Army unit used inflatable tanks, recorded sounds, and phony radio messages to fool Nazi forces. Their deceptions saved thousands of lives.

item.title: Sacsayhuamán: The Inca Fortress Built With Impossible Stones
item.description: Massive stone blocks weighing up to 200 tons fit together so perfectly that not even a sheet of paper fits between them. How did the Inca build Sacsayhuamán?

item.title: The Lost Colony of Roanoke: America's Oldest Mystery
item.description: In 1590, 117 English colonists vanished from Roanoke Island without a trace. The only clue was a single word carved into a tree: CROATOAN. What happened to them?

item.title: The Bennington Triangle: Vermont's Bermuda Triangle
item.description: Between 1945 and 1950, at least ten people vanished without a trace in a remote area of Vermont. No bodies were ever found. What happened in the Bennington Triangle?

item.title: The London Beer Flood of 1814: A Wave of Destruction
item.description: Over 300,000 gallons of beer burst from a brewery vat in 1814, flooding London streets, destroying homes, and killing eight people in one of history's strangest disasters.

item.title: The Saqqara Bird: Did Ancient Egyptians Understand Flight?
item.description: A 2,200-year-old wooden bird from Egypt has aerodynamic features that match modern aircraft design. Was it a toy, a ritual object, or proof of ancient flight knowledge?

item.title: The Copper Scroll Treasure: Ancient Treasure Map or Myth?
item.description: A 2,000-year-old copper scroll found near the Dead Sea describes billions in hidden gold and silver. Has anyone ever found the treasure?

item.title: Spontaneous Human Combustion: Can People Really Self-Ignite?
item.description: For over 300 years, people have reportedly burst into flames with no ignition source. Is spontaneous human combustion real, or is there a scientific explanation?

item.title: Thutmose II Tomb: The Lost Pharaoh Found!
item.description: Egypt announces the discovery of Thutmose II's tomb - the first royal tomb found since Tutankhamun in 1922!

item.title: The Mysterious Monoliths: Metal Pillars from Nowhere
item.description: Strange metal monoliths appeared in remote locations worldwide in 2020. Were they art, pranks, or something else entirely?

item.title: The Roman Dodecahedron: Ancient Mystery That Still Baffles Experts
item.description: Over 130 mysterious 12-sided bronze objects have been found across the Roman Empire, but no one knows what they were used for.

item.title: Pentagon UAP Reports 2024: What Does the Government Know?
item.description: The latest developments in the US government's investigation of unidentified anomalous phenomena.

item.title: Wilmer McLean: The Man Who Couldn't Escape the Civil War
item.description: The incredible true story of the man whose property witnessed both the first battle and final surrender of the American Civil War.

item.title: The New England Vampire Panic of 1892
item.description: When tuberculosis ravaged New England families, desperate communities turned to an unlikely culprit: vampires.

item.title: The Crystal Skulls - Past Mystery
item.description: Mysterious quartz skulls were once thought to be ancient Mayan artifacts with magical powers. But science revealed a surprising truth about their origins!

item.title: The Cadaver Synod - Past Mystery
item.description: A medieval pope put a dead pope on trial! This bizarre event in 897 CE remains one of history's strangest moments.

item.title: The Baghdad Battery - Past Mystery
item.description: A 2,000-year-old jar discovered in Iraq might be an ancient electric battery! Did ancient civilizations have electricity long before Edison?

item.title: The Hessdalen Lights - Past Mystery
item.description: Mysterious glowing lights have appeared in a Norwegian valley for decades. Scientists study them, but no one can fully explain what they are!

item.title: The Tunguska Event - Past Mystery
item.description: In 1908, something exploded over Siberia with the power of 1,000 atomic bombs. It flattened 800 square miles of forest - yet left no crater!

item.title: The Great Molasses Flood - Past Mystery
item.description: A massive wave of molasses destroyed a Boston neighborhood in 1919! How could sweet syrup cause so much destruction?

item.title: The Hum - Past Mystery
item.description: A mysterious low-frequency sound torments people around the world. Only some can hear it, but scientists still can't fully explain what causes it!

item.title: The Lost City of Heracleion - Past Mystery
item.description: A magnificent ancient Egyptian city that sank into the Mediterranean Sea and stayed hidden for over 1,200 years. Divers discovered temples, statues, and treasures beneath the waves!

item.title: Ball Lightning: The Ghost Orbs of Storms
item.description: Imagine a glowing ball of electricity floating through walls and doors. Scientists have tried to explain it for centuries, but ball lightning remains one of nature's biggest mysteries!

item.title: The Terracotta Army: 8,000 Clay Soldiers!
item.description: Farmers digging a well discovered an underground army of 8,000 life-sized clay soldiers - each one unique! This incredible army was buried over 2,200 years ago.

item.title: Indus Valley Civilization: Cities Before Their Time!
item.description: Over 4,000 years ago, people built cities with running water, flush toilets, and grid-planned streets. Then they vanished - and we still can't read their writing!

item.title: The Voynich Manuscript: The Book No One Can Read!
item.description: A 600-year-old book full of weird plants, secret codes, and naked people in green pools. The smartest people in the world have tried to read it - and all of them failed!

item.title: The Lost Fabergé Eggs: A Royal Treasure Hunt!
item.description: Imagine eggs made of gold and diamonds, each hiding a tiny secret inside. 8 of these magical treasures are still missing - could you be the one to find them?

item.title: The Nazca Lines: Giant Drawings in the Desert!
item.description: Mysterious giant drawings etched into the Peruvian desert over 2,000 years ago. They can only be seen from the sky - but why did ancient people make art they couldn't see?

item.title: The Dancing Plague: When People Danced to Their Death!
item.description: In 1518, a strange illness swept through Strasbourg. People couldn't stop dancing - even when their feet bled and their bodies gave out. What caused this mysterious plague?

item.title: The Battle of Los Angeles: Did UFOs Attack in 1942?
item.description: In 1942, Los Angeles was attacked by... something. For hours, the military fired over 1,400 shells at a mysterious object in the sky. But what was it?

item.title: The Antikythera Mechanism: An Ancient Computer!
item.description: Divers found a 2,000-year-old machine at the bottom of the ocean. It had gears like a clock - but ancient Greeks weren't supposed to have this technology!

item.title: Gobekli Tepe: The World's First Temple!
item.description: A temple built 12,000 years ago - before humans even invented farming! This discovery changed everything we thought we knew about ancient civilizations.

item.title: New Jersey Drones: The Mystery in the Sky!
item.description: Mysterious drones appeared over New Jersey neighborhoods, baffling residents and officials. What were they? Where did they come from? The mystery remains unsolved!

item.title: The Great Emu War: When Birds Defeated the Army!
item.description: In 1932, the Australian military went to war against 20,000 emus. The emus won. This is the hilarious true story of history's most embarrassing military campaign.
